channel.title: CODAC
channel.description: CODAC is a University of Florida-led center developing compositional methods for decision-making across optimization, dynamical systems, and control, using applied category theory and computational sheaf theory.

item.title: Research
item.description: The mathematical framework behind CODAC: categories of systems, functorial semantics, and sheaves as the common language for problems and solutions.
